name: theme_roshnilite
description: Dev tooling for theme_roshnilite: local Moodle Docker environment and coding-standards checker.

scripts.env:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.lint:php: for f in $(find . -name '*.php' -not -path './vendor/*' -not -path './node_modules/*'); do php -l "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:php && pnpm run lint:phpcs
scripts.build:zip: rm -rf build && mkdir -p build && sed -e 's#^theme_roshnilite/#/#' -e 's#/\*$##' exclude.lst | rsync -a --exclude-from=- ./ build/roshnilite/ && cd build && zip -rqX roshnilite.zip roshnilite && rm -rf roshnilite && echo "Created build/roshnilite.zip"
